final_message:
I finished the deviation report and it validates. It compares the DataPulse draft (Olmsted Harper, March 19, 2025) against Playbook v4.2 on all 22 provisions: 17 cross the Walk-Away line, 2 are within the Acceptable Fallback with minor drafting gaps (no-obligation-to-transact and amendments/waiver), and 3 comply (IP, entire agreement, counterparts). The six rated Critical are the standstill with its don't-ask-don't-waive clause (needs Board escalation), the representatives clause that excludes Ridgeline, the one-way remedies with $5M liquidated damages, non-circumvention, the unilateral publicity right, and the $10M liability cap that protects only DataPulse.
